_note: Semgrep requiere Python 3. Instala con: pip install semgrep. Luego ejecuta: semgrep --config p/typescript --config p/nextjs --config p/owasp-top-ten --json -o security/semgrep-report.json apps/web/src
_run_command: semgrep --config p/typescript --config p/nextjs --config p/owasp-top-ten --json -o security/semgrep-report.json apps/web/src

findings.title: Log injection via user-controlled label field
findings.description: User-supplied label was sliced to 120 chars but newlines (\n, \r) were not stripped, allowing fake log line injection on staging.

findings.title: Environment name disclosed in public health endpoint
findings.description: VERCEL_ENV value (production/preview/development) was returned in unauthenticated /api/health response.
findings.fix_applied: Removed 'environment' field from all response bodies

findings.title: Public DB-hitting endpoint with no rate limit
findings.description: /api/health performs a SELECT on 'users' table on every call with no rate limiting, enabling DB stress via unauthenticated requests.
findings.fix_applied: Added rateLimitByKey({ limit: 60, windowSeconds: 60 }) keyed by IP

findings.title: Rate limit only by IP, not by user — VPN-bypass risk
findings.description: A single authenticated user cycling IPs (VPN) could bypass the 30 req/60s IP rate limit and trigger unlimited Anthropic API calls (cost amplification) without consuming all their tokens.
findings.fix_applied: Added secondary rateLimitByKey({ key: 'consult:user:{userId}', limit: 15, windowSeconds: 60 })

findings.title: In-memory rate limit fallback is ineffective on Vercel serverless
findings.description: rateLimitByKey() falls back to an in-process Map when UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL/TOKEN are not set. On Vercel, each invocation may be a different worker, making the in-memory bucket useless. If Upstash is not configured in production, ALL rate limits are bypassed.
findings.action: Configure UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN in Vercel production environment variables. Create a free Upstash Redis instance at upstash.com.

findings.title: Webhook signature verification
findings.description: VERIFIED: Uses timingSafeEqual() via SHA-256 hash comparison. Bearer prefix normalized before comparison. Secret loaded from REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var. Fails closed (503) if env var not set.

findings.title: Supabase service role key handling
findings.description: VERIFIED: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is only referenced in supabase-admin.ts (server-only). No NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix. Never imported in client components. Admin client uses { auth: { persistSession: false } }.

findings.title: No hardcoded secrets found
findings.description: Full grep scan across all .ts/.tsx source files found no hardcoded API keys, tokens, or secrets. All sensitive values are loaded via process.env.*

findings.title: No .env files tracked in git
findings.description: git ls-files returns no .env* files. .gitignore blocks .env and .env.* patterns.

findings.title: postcss HIGH vulnerability via Next.js (GHSA-q4gf-8mx6-v5v3)
findings.description: postcss (transitive dep of Next.js 15.x) has a DoS vulnerability. Only HIGH vulnerability that touches production runtime. Fix available without breaking changes.
findings.action: Run: cd apps/web && npm audit fix
